metadata.family_label: Fasteners, Nut Traps and Heat Inserts
metadata.scope: Hex nut traps, square nut traps, heat-set brass inserts, counterbores, countersinks, bolt clearance holes.

material_suggestions.use_case: heat-set threaded inserts in printed parts
material_suggestions.notes: Press in with soldering iron; pull-out strength ×5 vs self-tap in PLA.

material_suggestions.use_case: bolts and nuts for corrosion-sensitive assemblies
material_suggestions.notes: Good in wet environments; lower strength than 8.8 carbon steel.
Yield 640 MPa; coat or plate for corrosion resistance.

standards_used.name: ISO 4762 socket cap screws
standards_used.note: M3 head OD 5.5 mm, height 3 mm; M4 head OD 7 mm, height 4 mm.

standards_used.name: ISO 4032 hexagon nuts
standards_used.note: M3 nut: F-F 5.5 mm, height 2.4 mm; M4: F-F 7.0 mm, height 3.2 mm.

standards_used.name: ISO 965 metric thread tolerances
standards_used.note: 6H tolerance; print at minor diameter for self-tap; add 0.1–0.15 mm for ease.

output_policy.openscad_code: Geometry-only OpenSCAD with named parameters, one module, and no prose.

parts.name: M3 hexagonal nut trap pocket

fit_guidance_mm.hex_pocket: ISO 4032 F-F + 0.2 mm = 5.7 mm; depth = nut height + 0.2 mm

main_features: coaxial bolt clearance through-hole extending past pocket
design_rules: hex pocket is cylinder with $fn=6 sized by outer-circle diameter
bolt clearance extends further than hex pocket
pocket rotated 30° so flat faces align with print orientation if needed
failure_modes: pocket too shallow — nut falls out

constraint_checks.message: Hex nut trap must use cylinder with $fn=6 for correct hex profile.
